$comment: Pinned KTX-Software CLI used by the texture encoder. Verify archive SHA256 before installation. Linux RIDs use tarballs; Windows RIDs use NSIS installers and require explicit elevation. The installer writes into the cache and may register an uninstall entry. macOS RIDs are omitted; install separately and set PARADISE_KTX_PATH. When updating, verify published digests where available and record the SHA256 of each selected asset.
$versionComment: KtxTool targets the v5 ktx create interface rather than legacy toktx. This manifest pins a prerelease; validate encoder arguments and texture integration tests before changing versions.
